name: RE-Bench
description: RE-Bench is a benchmark consisting of 7 challenging, open-ended machine learning research engineering environments designed to evaluate AI agents' R&D capabilities against human experts, including data from 71 human expert attempts.
reputation: A new benchmark for AI research engineering agents that is emerging in the literature, but it has not yet reached broad community standardization.
notes: Includes human expert data and agent trajectories; compares AI agents and humans on time-budgeted tasks.
